text: Shechaniah: Or, Shebaniah | Rehum: Or, Harim | Merimoth: Or, Meraioth
Miamin: Or, Miniamin | Madiah: Or, Moadiah
the thanksgiving: That is, the Psalms of thanksgiving
sang loud: Heb. made their voice to be heard
of the law: that is, appointed by the law | for Judah: Heb. for the joy of Judah | that waited: Heb. that stood
